packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major updates once the test workflow passes.
Major updates: open a PR but require manual review/merge.

Skip TypeScript 7.0.x: it ships no stable programmatic API, so typescript-eslint (peer typescript <6.1.0) can't run on it and the frontend install/lint breaks. The API is targeted for 7.1 — allow that through so a fresh PR reopens when it lands.
Node is pinned in three places (Dockerfile, .nvmrc, setup-node). A split bump would leave CI building on a different major than the image, so bump them together.
hls.js 1.7.x interstitials scheduler stalls before the first fragment on our fMP4 VOD renditions; hold at 1.6.x until fixed upstream.

customManagers.description: golangci-lint is curl-installed in CI, so no built-in manager sees the pinned version.
setup-node's node-version. Kept in one group with the Dockerfile node image and .nvmrc so all three move together.
Swift package dependencies live in apple/project.yml (xcodegen input), which no built-in manager reads.
